name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's passion for motorsport ignited during his university days, fueled by late-night viewings of Formula 1 races. After graduating with a degree in aerospace engineering, he quickly immersed himself in the world of aerodynamics, starting as a junior aerodynamicist at a smaller racing outfit. His dedication and knack for identifying innovative solutions propelled him through the ranks. 

At Haas F1 Team, Park emphasizes a data-driven approach coupled with creative problem-solving. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where his team can freely explore unconventional ideas. His meticulous nature and commitment to reliability make him a vital asset in the pursuit of aerodynamic excellence, constantly seeking marginal gains that can translate to significant performance improvements on the track. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure, a quality highly valued within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight wave
physical.description: He has a lean build and a focused gaze that conveys his deep concentration.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic calculations.
Drinks exactly three cups of green tea throughout the day, each brewed for a precise duration.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
